svg.title: Parc, a calm home screen for Android
svg.desc: Wordmark Parc with the line 'Your apps sit on arcs, right under your thumb.' On the right, five quarter-circle arcs sweep up from a hub near the bottom-right corner, with apps resting on them and a faint protractor scale around the outside. A line drags out from the hub, aims at an app, and the app opens when it is released. Free, open source, no accounts, ads or tracking.
